{
  "project_id": "{{projectId}}",
  "title": "Newman: checkout button does nothing",
  "description": "Found by the API suite",
  "steps_to_reproduce": [
    "Open the cart",
    "Click Pay"
  ],
  "expected_result": "A receipt",
  "actual_result": "Nothing happens",
  "label_ids": [
    "{{bugLabelId}}"
  ]
}

exec: pm.test("key, status and defaults", () => { pm.expect(b.key).to.match(/^[A-Z]{2,6}-[0-9]+$/); pm.expect(b.number).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("new"); pm.expect(b.severity).to.eql("medium"); pm.expect(b.priority).to.eql("p3"); pm.expect(b.labels.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(b.sla_breached).to.eql(false); });
